desc:
💪 Train. Fight. Break Free.

🏋️ Train in the cell to increase your raw power
💪 Watch your muscles grow in real time
🔪 Unlock and equip stronger gear
🐾 Collect pets to boost your training speed
💥 Destroy the jail and defeat the guards

Each prisoner is more dangerous than the last. Do you have what it takes to break the walls and taste freedom?
